title: Phone map fills the screen (no dark bar)
description: On a phone the board column (min-height 55vh) had no definite height, so the map container fell back to the SVG's aspect ratio: at 412x915 the map was 367 px tall inside a 503 px column, the remaining 136 px were an empty dark band under the map, and a zoomed or panned map was cut off by a straight edge above that band (hex tips visible at the cut). The column now grows to the bottom of the screen and the board fills it. Synthetic game-over fixture on the 37-tile gallery map through a mocked server (the offline BGA balanced map cannot be loaded here; the cause does not depend on the map, only on its aspect ratio versus the column). The before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the commit without the fix.

shots.heading: Before: 412x915
shots.caption: Map container ends at y=407; empty dark band down to the buttons.

shots.heading: After: 412x915
shots.caption: The map container covers the whole area above the buttons.
